newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Japan takes most Alumbrera copper - MIM.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Japan takes most Alumbrera copper - MIM.

text.p: Japanese customers have agreed to purchase the bulk of the output of copper concentrates from Argentina's Alumbrera mine once production starts next year, an MIM spokesman told Reuters on Tuesday.

MIM, which holds a 50 percent interest in Alumbrera, has signed sales agreements or obtained letters of intent covering 85 percent of the forecast 700,000 tonnes of concentrates scheduled to be produced annually from the mine, he said.
The sales are structured under the "frame" system, meaning terms vary with the price of copper and treatment and refining fees over the life of the contract, the spokesman said.
The contracts extend for as long as 10 years, he said.
"The largest buyers are the Japanese but material also is going to (South) Korea, Europe, Brazil and some to North America," he said.
Construction of the US$903 million project has been accelerated, with the mine's first shipments due in the second quarter of 1997/1998, he said.
MIM has said it expects higher production in the early years of operation than earlier planned.
North Ltd and Canada's Rio Algom Ltd each own the remaining 25 percent stakes in the project.
